verdict.rationale: The registry names a sanctioned third-party rail: a 'registered intermediary' filing channel with its own pricing and processing time (docs-9). It also has delegated roles, 'full access manager' and 'filing collaborator', plus a corporation key and shared-access permissions through which someone else can file for the corporation (docs-15). These are only passing mentions, with no detail on how a provider qualifies or what it may do. Missing for 10: documentation of how a provider becomes a registered intermediary or is granted filing-collaborator access, the scope and limits of what delegates may file, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
